scientific_question: Within a fixed CHORUS-Final architecture, does U(1)-neutral Hermitian closure improve generalisation beyond a parameter-matched non-Hermitian quadratic control?
estimand_scope: The causal effect of the configured quadratic closure within this architecture, optimiser, data split, and training budget; not a universal necessity claim for every equivariant model.

interventions.off: MACE-ICTC backbone without the CHORUS density residual
interventions.charge2: parameter-matched non-Hermitian z tensor z control
interventions.full: U(1)-neutral Hermitian z tensor z-star density

dataset_roles.bucky: MD22 buckyball catcher, 600-frame training split and large held-out test
dataset_roles.3bpa: 3BPA 450/50 training/validation with 300 K, 600 K, and 1200 K tests

selection.checkpoint: minimum full-validation Force MAE; earliest validation breaks exact ties

analysis.effect_scale: paired log error ratio and relative error reduction
analysis.aggregation: dataset-level effects first, then equal-weight macro average across datasets
analysis.causal_dag: causal_dag.md and causal_dag.dot in this directory
analysis.identification: Every intervention is executed within every dataset-by-seed stratum. Dataset, split, seed, architecture, optimiser, precision, step budget, and checkpoint rule are fixed or blocked by pairing.
analysis.primary_causal_estimand: The paired algorithmic intervention effect of replacing charge-2 z tensor z closure with U(1)-neutral Hermitian z tensor z-star closure on held-out Force MAE, including optimisation and validation-based checkpoint selection as downstream mediators.
analysis.non_identified_decomposition: Full versus Charge2 identifies the joint Hermitian-plus-U(1)-neutral closure. It does not separately identify Hermiticity and charge neutrality because no valid intervention changes one while holding the other fixed.
analysis.existing_runs: context and pilot evidence only; not pooled into the new primary estimand
analysis.dataset_sampling_scope: The four systems are a predeclared mechanism-probing panel informed by prior experiments, not a random sample of chemical systems. Macro effects therefore apply to this panel rather than to all MLIPs or all materials.
